claude-bridge/claude-fable-5-1.character: Advisory: The advisor's own session model, including planning and synthesis, at medium reasoning. Shares the Anthropic session allowance; delegate implementation and checking when useful to conserve capacity, not because the advisor cannot do them. At Anthropic capacity, the advisor session falls back to Grok at high.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.character: Advisory: Use leftover Codex quota here first: the procedural-tier workhorse at high reasoning for mechanical chores, routine checks, repair verification, test-harness findings, browser verification, and implementation from a locked execution packet; at xhigh it is a fresh-context checker for schema, auth, security, money, and data boundaries. Own investigation, local planning, implementation or repair, and verification within the assignment. For locked packets, fix material decisions and deterministic anchors; resolve tooling obstacles locally and escalate material ambiguity outside the assignment. If Codex is fully exhausted, existing profile fallback guidance still applies.

claude-bridge/claude-opus-5.character: Advisory: Genuinely new or greenfield UX/frontend implementation when the Anthropic 5-hour window is healthy, preferably with frontend-design loaded, and optional fresh-context adversarial review when Sonnet is the maker or risk is extreme. Runs at medium. Sonnet is the default builder; Grok is the UX fallback after a capacity limit. Own local planning and verification, but prefer cheaper choices for routine existing-UX tweaks.

claude-bridge/claude-sonnet-5.character: Advisory: The decision-bearing implementation workhorse and default adversarial-tier checker. Backend, mixed-stack, substantial existing-UX, tests, schema/auth/security/money checks, and final whole-diff review. Own investigation, planning, implementation or repair, and verification within the assignment. Prefer Sol for a locked execution packet while Codex capacity is available. Prefer a fresh Sonnet context for review of a Sonnet build. Load frontend-design for UX work. 1M window. Opus takes greenfield UX while the 5-hour window is fresh.

cursor/grok-4.6.character: Advisory: Overflow generalist when Anthropic capacity is tight: research, bounded backend, mixed-stack, existing-UX, planning fallback, and procedural work if Sol is unavailable. Load frontend-design for UX work. 200K window — keep packets bounded. This guide recommends Cursor only as cursor/grok-4.6. Preserve Cursor catalog fast-mode default.
